questions.question: Two sides of a triangle are 12.8 m and 9.6 m. If the height of the triangle is 12 m, corresponding to 9.6 m then what its height (in m) corresponding to 12.8 m?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c1c65b329ca9f380e9f52c14ca18bd351e2e0532878d39647a6c34be2e4f9ce.png] 

**Given:**

Two sides of a triangle = 12.8 m & 9.6 m 

**Formula used:**

Area of a triangle = 1/2 × Base × Height

**Calculation:**

Let the height of the corresponding side 12.8 m = h 

1/2 × 9.6 × 12 = 1/2&
amp;nbsp;× 12.8 × h

⇒ (9.6 × 12)/12.8 = h 

⇒ h = 9 m 

**∴ The height of the triangle corresponding to side with length 12.8 m long = 9 m**

questions.question: If x⁴ - 142x² + 1 = 0, then the value of x³ + 1/x³ is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x4-14x2+1 = 0

**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:**

x4 - 142x2 + 1 = 0

By dividing the equation by x²

⇒ x² - 142 + 1/x² = 0 

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 142

By adding 2 in both LHS & RHS

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 + 2 = 142 + 2

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 144

⇒ (x + 1/x) = √144 = 12 

By Cubing both sides

⇒ (x + 1/x)³ = 12³

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3 × x × 1/x (x + 1/x) = 1728

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = 1728 - 3 × (x + 1/x) = 1728 - 3 × 12 

⇒ 1728 - 36 = 1692

**∴ x3 + 1/x3 = 1692**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**If (x² + 1/x²) = a; then (x + 1/x) = √(a + 2) = k 

If (x + 1/x) = k; then (x3 + 1/x3) = k³ - 3k

⇒ If x2 + 1/x2 = 142; then (x + 1/x) = √(142 + 2) = 12

**∴ If (x + 1/x) = 12; then (x3 + 1/x3) = 123 - 3 × 12 = 1692**

questions.question: In ∆ ABC, ∠B = 90⁰ , AB = 8 cm and BC = 15 cm, D is a point on BC such that AD bisects ∠A. The length (in cm) of BD is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In ∆ ABC, ∠B = 90°, AB = 8 cm and BC = 15 cm

AD is the angle bisector of ∠A

**Concept:**

Angle Bisector Theorem = The angle bisector of any angle will divide the opposite side in the ratio of the sides containing the angle. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f6e6ca96b1b11ea926abc7ebe63a9c186dc6e0e26634c16bdb0ee4d803a4338.png] 

Here, BD/DC = AB/AC

**Calculation:**

By Pythagoras Theorem

AB² + BC² = AC²

⇒ 8² + 15² = AC²

⇒ AC = √289 = 17 cm.

Now, BD/DC = AB/AC

⇒ BD/DC = 8/17

⇒ BD + DC = 8x + 17x = 25x 

⇒ BD = 15 cm × 8x/25x

**∴ BD = 4.8 cm **

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs 1,000 After two successive discounts, it is sold for Rs 600, If the first discount is x% and the second discount is 25%, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) of the article = Rs.1000 

Selling Price (SP) of the article = Rs.600

First discount = x% 

Second discount = 25%

**Formula used:**

Discount = MP - SP 

SP after discount = MP × (100 - Discount%)/100

**Calculation:**

SP of the article after the first discount = 1000 × (100 - x)/100 = 10 × (100 - x) 

SP of the article after the second discount = 10 × (100 - x) × (100 - 25)/100 

⇒ 10 × (100 - x) × 75/100 = 600 

⇒ (100 - x) = 600 × 100/75 × 1/10 

⇒ 100 - x = 80 

⇒ x = 20

**∴ The first discount percent = 20%**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Formulas used:

Discount rate = Discount/MP × 100 

Also, x + y -xy/100 

Second discount = 25%

Total Discount = 1000 - 600 = 400 

Effective rate of discount = 400/1000 × 100 

⇒ 40% 

Effective rate of discount = x + y - xy/100 

⇒ x + 25% - x × 25/100 

⇒ 40% = x + 25% - x/4 

⇒ 15% = x - x/4 

⇒ 15% = 3x/4 

**⇒ x = 15% × 4/3 = 20%**

questions.question: Given that (2x + y)³ - (x + 2y)³ = (x - y) [A(x² + y²) + Bxy], the value of (2A - B) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

**Formula used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:**

(2x + y)3 - (x + 2y)3 = (x - y) [A(x2 + y2) + Bxy]

⇒ (2x)³ + y³ + 3 × 2x × y(2x + y) - (x)3 - (2y)³ - 3 × x × 2y (x + 2y) = (x - y) [Ax2 + Ay2 + Bxy]

⇒ 8x³ + y3 + 12x²y + 6xy² - x³ - 8y³ - 6x2y - 12xy² = [Ax3 + Axy²+ Bx²y - Ax²y - Ay3 - Bxy2]

⇒ 7x3 - 7y3 + 6x2y - 6xy2 = Ax3 - Ay3 + (B - A)x2y + (A - B)xy2

By comparison on LHS and RHS

⇒ A = 7, (B - A) = 6, (A - B) = - 6

⇒ (B - 7) = 6 

⇒ B = 13

**∴ (2A - B) = (2 × 7 - 13) **

**⇒ 1**

value of (2A - B) = 2 × 7 - 13

questions.question: A and B complete a work in 80 days and 96 days, respectively. They completed the work in 32 days with the help of C, How many days will C take to complete the entire work alone?
questions.solution:

Days taken by A = 80 

Days taken by B = 96 

Days taken by A, B and C together = 32

No of days taken = Work/ Efficiency per day 

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be = 1 

Work done be A per day = 1/80 

Work done by B per day = 1/96 

Work done by A, B and C per day = 1/32 

⇒ Work done by only C per day = 1/32 - 1/80 - 1/96 

⇒ (15 - 6 - 5)/480 = 4

questions.question: If a number is divisible by 624, the remainder will be 53, If the same number is divisible by 16, then the remainder will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

When a number is divided by 624, the remainder will be 53. 

**Formula used:**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder 

**Calculation:**

Let the number be = N 

⇒N/624, Remainder = 53

If N is completely divisible by 624 then N is also divisible by 16

⇒ so the answer depends on the remainder only

⇒ 53/16 = 5 remainder

**∴ The required remainder = 5**

questions.question: The average age of 125 students in a group is 16.2 years. 40% of the students are boys and the rest are girls. The average age of the boys is 20% more than the average age of the girls. What is the average age (in years) of the boys?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average age of 125 students = 16.2 years 

Percentage of boys = 40% = 125 × 2/5 = 50 

Percentage of girls = 60% = 125 × 3/5 = 75 

**Formula used:**

Average age of a group of students = Total age ÷ No of students 

**Calculation:**

Let the average age of girls = y years 

⇒ Average age of boys = y × 120% = 6y/5 years 

Now As per the question

75 × y + 50 × 6y/5 = 16.2 × 125 

⇒ 75y + 60y = 2025

⇒ y = 15 

⇒ 6y/5 = 15 × 6/5 = 18 

**∴ Average age of boys = 18 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**By Ratio Method

Let the average age of girls = 5y

20% in fraction means 1/5 

⇒ Average age of boys = 1 + 5 = 6y 

Ratio of the number of boys and girls = 40% : 60% 

⇒ 2 : 3

(5y × 3 + 6y × 2)÷ 5 = 16.2 years 

⇒ 15y + 12y = 81 

⇒ 27y = 81 

⇒ y = 3 

**∴ 6y = 6 × 3 = 18 years **

questions.question: Train A takes 1(4)/(5)h more than the time taken by train B to cover a distance of 360 km. If the speed of train A doubles, it will take 36 min less than the time taken by train B to travel the same distance. What is the speed (in km/h) of train B?

Distance = 360 km 

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed 

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of train A = a 

Let the speed of train B = b 

As per the question; 

360/a - 360/b = 9/5 hours 

⇒ 1/a - 1/b = 1/200 (1)

360/b - 360/2a = 36/60 hours 

⇒ 1/b - 1/2a = 1/600 (2)

By (1) ÷ 2 and then (1) + (2) 

⇒ 1/2a - 1/2b + 1/b - 1/2a = 1/400 + 1/600 

⇒ 1/2b = 5/1200 

⇒ b = 120 

**∴ The speed of train B = 120 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Ratio Method:**

The ratio of Speed of A = 1(original speed) : 2(New speed)

This time is the difference between the original time and the new time 

⇒ 2x - x = 144

⇒ x = 144

According to the question, A takes 108 mins more than B.

⇒ A= 108 + B

⇒ 288 = 108 + B

The time is taken by B = 180 mins

3 hours Distance covered by B = 360 km time taken by B

questions.question: A straight vertical pole was broken during a cyclone in such a way that its top touched the ground at a distance of 6sqrt 3 m from the bottom of the pole and made and angle of 30° with the horizontal. What was the height (in m) of the pole?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a **30°-60°-90°** triangle, the side ratios are **1 : √3 : 2**.

Distance from base (√3 part) = 6√3 m ⇒ 1 unit = 6 m.

Height of broken part (1 unit) = 6 m and Hypotenuse (2 units) = 12 m.

Total height of **vertical pole** = 6 + 12 = 18 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3eb7e80e74a742c56d4abc107331ea0efe2ecace20019979a21be259dc4f678c.png] 

**Given:** Distance BC = 6√3 m, Angle of elevation θ = 30°.

**Formula Used:** tan θ = Perpendicular/Base; cos θ = Base/Hypotenuse.

⇒ In triangle ABC, tan 30° = AB / BC

⇒ 1/√3 = AB / 6√3

⇒ AB = 6 m (Height of standing part)

⇒ cos 30° = BC / AC

⇒ √3/2 = 6√3 / AC

⇒ AC = 12 m (Length of broken part)

⇒ Total height of pole = AB + AC = 6 + 12 = 18 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios

Common values: tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 45° = 1, tan 60° = √3.

Height and Distance

The total height of a **broken object** is the sum of the vertical segment and the slant hypotenuse segment.

Standard Triangle Proportions

For a 30° angle, the ratio of Height : Base : Hypotenuse is always 1 : √3 : 2.</p
